text:
deploybot: starting deployment to prod-canary — commit=ab12c3d tag=v2.14.3. kicking off 3 migrations: add_user_idx, backfill_usage_flags, schema_cleanup. logs: `mig-runner start job=add_user_idx id=23`

alice: seeing job #24 (backfill_usage_flags) move to FAILED, error: `unique constraint violation on user_id` — tail of log: `Error: duplicate key value violates unique constraint "usage_pkey"`

bob: canary traffic shows 5xx spike, correlated with backfill errors. suggest abort canary and rollback migration set. cc @dave_oncall

carol: pushed quick check — the backfill batch keying was off (batch size 1k -> 10k). probably caused lock contention with live writes.

dave_oncall: agree with rollback. instructing deploybot: revert DB state for canary, stop further migration jobs, pin tag to v2.14.2 for canary until fix. Please run `rollback migrations id=24,23` and halt rollout.

deploybot: received. halting remaining migration jobs. rollback started for jobs [24,23]. starting down migration for add_user_idx (job=23).

deploybot: rollback finished for jobs [24,23]. canary deployment marked ABORTED. pinned canary to tag=v2.14.2. details: https://deploy.internal/reports/1868004321

sre-bot: autometrics: error rate returned to baseline within 3m after rollback. opening incident for postmortem and migration test harness improvements.

alice: filing PR to add idempotency checks and smaller backfill batches. will include canary-only dry-run step.

dave_oncall: good. schedule hotfix plan with product for dedicated change window. thanks all :thumbsup:
